text:
Maya (CS): FYI — Acme returned their vendor questionnaire with several non-standard answers and attached multiple screenshots. They're asking if screenshots are acceptable evidence for our SOC2/DPA review. Can we accept? looping @Tom @Janelle

Tom (Security): Screenshots are okay for UI flows or showing settings, but not for anything containing secrets or key material. Prefer original export (PDF/CSV) or a signed attestation. For embeddings retention: our standard retention is 90 days unless a different term is specified in the DPA. If they need longer we need a legal exception.

Janelle (Privacy): Agreed. Also need to confirm whether the screenshots contain PII or account identifiers. If so, they must be redacted before we store. If they insist on keeping longer retention for embeddings, escalate to legal for addendum.

Maya (CS): I'll ask them for: 1) original exported questionnaire or PDF, 2) redacted logs if any, 3) explicit statement on why screenshots only. Also asking for the 'answers.json' from their GRC tool if available.

Tom (Security): Note for BYOK/BYOK‑like responses: screenshots of key material are unacceptable. If they claim BYOK, request Key Policy doc and KMS metadata (key ID, rotation policy).

Maya (CS): Draft message to customer (happy to tweak):
```
Hi Emma — thanks for sending the questionnaire. A couple quick asks so we can complete the review:
- Please attach the original questionnaire export or a signed PDF instead of screenshots where possible.
- If screenshots are the only option, redact any account IDs or key identifiers.
- For embeddings retention: can you confirm the retention period you expect? Our standard is 90 days; longer retention requires a DPA addendum.
- If you're using BYOK, please attach the KMS policy and key metadata (key ID, region, rotation cadence).

Thanks — Maya, Redwood CS
```

OpsBot: Created ticket CS-7892 and linked this thread :white_check_mark:

Janelle (Privacy): Adding legal@redwood to the thread for addendum language. @legal please advise on minimum acceptable evidence and DPA addendum wording.

Tom (Security): If legal ok, we can accept redacted screenshots + attestation to avoid delaying onboarding. But prefer original exports.

Maya (CS): Great — I'll send the draft now and attach the checklist. Will update the ticket once they reply. :thumbsup:
